curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with what sign shapes and colors announce, then the stop sign and the yield sign side by side, then the other regulation signs.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per sign family; a contrast card on stop versus yield.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a sign color or shape and asking what it means or requires.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover yellow warnings with advisory speeds, orange work-zone signs with enforceable limits, green destination signs and route markers, and blue service signs.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each sign family; a contrast card on yellow advice versus orange orders.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a sign and asking whether it advises or orders.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain signal layouts and dead signals, steady red and turns on red, flashing red and red arrows, the yellows, the greens, and overhead lane lights.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per signal; contrast cards on the three reds and the flashing versus steady yellows.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz naming a light and asking what movement it allows.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what road paint does, white versus yellow lines, the four center-line patterns as a strictness ladder, stop lines and crosswalks, and lane arrows.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per marking; contrast cards on the line ladder and on when paint alone forces a stop.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a line pattern and asking whether you may pass or cross.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover diamond lanes and who may use them, then why officer directions override every sign, signal and marking, including dead-signal fallbacks.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for diamond lanes and officer authority; contrast cards on diamond-lane exceptions and dead-signal fallbacks.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on who may use a diamond lane and whose direction wins.
